hooks.command: if [ -z "${DOOMPI_HOOK_GROUPS+x}" ] || printf ',%s,' "$DOOMPI_HOOK_GROUPS" | grep -Fq ',scaffold-mcp,'; then REPO="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" && [ -f "$REPO/node_modules/@agiflowai/scaffold-mcp/dist/cli.cjs" ] && node "$REPO/node_modules/@agiflowai/scaffold-mcp/dist/cli.cjs" hook --type claude-code.preToolUse || true; fi

if [ -z "${DOOMPI_HOOK_GROUPS+x}" ] || printf ',%s,' "$DOOMPI_HOOK_GROUPS" | grep -Fq ',vibe-lint,'; then REPO="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" && [ -f "$REPO/node_modules/@agimon-ai/vibe-lint/dist/cli.mjs" ] && node "$REPO/node_modules/@agimon-ai/vibe-lint/dist/cli.mjs" hook --type claude-code.preToolUse || true; fi

if [ -n "$WORKFLOW_DECISION_FILE" ]; then CLI="$WORKFLOW_RUN_DIR/bin/workflow-mcp"; if [ -x "$CLI" ]; then "$CLI" claude-stop-hook; else echo "workflow-stop: $CLI is missing, so this step cannot record how it ended" >&2; exit 1; fi; else CLI="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/node_modules/@agimon-ai/workflow-mcp/dist/cli.mjs"; if [ -n "$WORKFLOW_STATUS_FILE" ]; then if [ -f "$CLI" ]; then node "$CLI" claude-stop-hook; else echo "workflow-stop: $CLI is missing, so this step cannot record that it ended" >&2; exit 1; fi; elif [ -f "$CLI" ]; then node "$CLI" claude-stop-hook || true; fi; fi

if [ -z "${DOOMPI_HOOK_GROUPS+x}" ] || printf ',%s,' "$DOOMPI_HOOK_GROUPS" | grep -Fq ',vibe-lint,'; then REPO="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" && [ -f "$REPO/node_modules/@agimon-ai/vibe-lint/dist/cli.mjs" ] && node "$REPO/node_modules/@agimon-ai/vibe-lint/dist/cli.mjs" hook --type claude-code.postToolBatch || true; fi
